{{Short description|Spanish-Catalan physicist}}

'''Maria Roser Valentí''' (born 1963<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2026-10-01 |date=2023-01-20 |language=es |title=La docente e investigadora Maria Roser Valentí Vall recibirá el tercer Premio Rosa Argelaguet i Isanta - Premio del Campus Manresa |url=https://www.umanresa.cat/es/comunicacion/noticias/la-docente-e-investigadora-maria-roser-valenti-vall-recibira-el-tercer-premio |website=umanresa.cat}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>) is a Spanish-Catalonian professor of theoretical [[condensed matter physics]] at [[Goethe University Frankfurt|Johann Wolfgang Goethe-Universität Frankfurt am Main]].<ref name=":0">{{cite web |last= |date= |year= |title=Prof. Dr. Roser Valentí |url=https://itp.uni-frankfurt.de/~valenti/index.php?id=cv |url-status= |archive-url= |archive-date= |access-date= |publisher= |pages= |language= |format= |quote= |periodical=}}</ref>

== Biography ==
In 1987, Valentí graduated from the [[University of Barcelona]] with honors.<ref name=":0" /> In 1989, she finished her doctoral thesis in theoretical [[condensed matter physics]] with distinction at the University of Barcelona.<ref>{{Cite thesis |last=Valenti |first=Maria Roser |title=Estudi de sistemes de baixa dimensionalitat i correlació electrònica forta pel mètode de la matriu de transferència : tesi doctoral |degree=PhD |publisher=Universitat de Barcelona |year=1989 |language=ca}}</ref> After her dissertation was completed, she was named a [[Fulbright Program|Fulbright-Fellow]] allowing her to study at the [[University of Florida]].<ref name=":0" />
